# EasyShop E-Commerce - Complete Autonomous Shopping Agent API Specification

Version: 1.0.0
Base URL: https://easyshop.ir/api/v1
Format: JSON (Accept: application/json, Content-Type: application/json)
Character Set: UTF-8 (Persian text normalized: standard ZWNJ \u200C, unified Yehs/Kafs)

## 1. Authentication & Security
- Customer accounts use passwordless Mobile OTP:
  - `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/request` { "mobile": "09123456789", "captcha_key": "uuid", "captcha_code": "1234" }
  - `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/verify` { "mobile": "09123456789", "code": "12345" } -> Returns Sanctum bearer token.
- Guest sessions can read all public catalog endpoints without authentication.

## 2. Catalog & Discovery Endpoints

### 2.1 GET /categories/tree
Returns the full multi-level category taxonomy.
Response Schema:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "مراقبت از پوست",
      "slug": "skincare",
      "icon": "i-lucide-sparkles",
      "children": [
        {
          "id": 2,
          "name": "کرم ضد آفتاب",
          "slug": "sunscreen",
          "children": []
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

### 2.2 GET /products
Search and filter products with pagination.
Parameters:
- `q` (string, optional): Search keyword. Supports Persian characters and fuzzy matching.
- `category` (string, optional): Category slug.
- `brand` (string, optional): Brand slug.
- `min_price` (integer, optional): Minimum price in Rials.
- `max_price` (integer, optional): Maximum price in Rials.
- `in_stock` (boolean/integer, optional): `1` for in-stock items only.
- `sort` (string, enum): `latest`, `cheapest`, `expensive`, `popular`, `bestselling`.
- `page` (integer, default: 1): Page number.
- `per_page` (integer, default: 16): Items per page.

Response Schema:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 10,
      "name": "کرم ضد آفتاب بی‌رنگ فیوژن واتر SPF50",
      "slug": "isdin-fusion-water-spf50",
      "thumbnail": "https://easyshop.ir/storage/products/thumbnail.webp",
      "brand": { "id": 2, "name": "ایزدین", "slug": "isdin" },
      "category": { "id": 5, "name": "ضد آفتاب", "slug": "sunscreen" },
      "primary_price": 12500000,
      "primary_compare_at_price": 14000000,
      "price_range": { "min": 12500000, "max": 12500000 },
      "is_in_stock": true,
      "is_featured": true,
      "variants_count": 1
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "current_page": 1,
    "last_page": 5,
    "per_page": 16,
    "total": 78
  }
}
```

### 2.3 GET /products/{slug}
Returns full detail for a single product including its variant matrix.
Response Schema:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": 10,
    "name": "کرم پودر مات ۲۴ ساعته",
    "slug": "loreal-infallible-24h-foundation",
    "short_description": "پوشش‌دهی کامل با ماندگاری ۲۴ ساعته مناسب انواع پوست",
    "description": "توضیحات کامل تخصصی محصول...",
    "brand": { "id": 3, "name": "لورال", "name_en": "L'Oreal", "slug": "loreal" },
    "category": { "id": 8, "name": "کرم پودر", "slug": "foundation" },
    "images": [
      "https://easyshop.ir/storage/products/1.webp",
      "https://easyshop.ir/storage/products/2.webp"
    ],
    "scoped_attributes": [
      {
        "id": 1,
        "name": "شماره رنگ",
        "values": [
          { "id": 101, "value": "شماره ۱۱۰ عاجی", "color_hex": "#F4E3D7" },
          { "id": 102, "value": "شماره ۱۲۰ بژ روشن", "color_hex": "#E8D3C0" }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "available_variants": [
      {
        "id": 25,
        "sku": "LOR-INF-110",
        "price": 9500000,
        "compare_at_price": 11000000,
        "stock": 14,
        "weight": 120,
        "attribute_value_ids": [101]
      }
    ],
    "average_rating": 4.8,
    "reviews_count": 32
  }
}
```

## 3. Pricing & Currency Conversion
- Backend figures are stored in **IRR (Rials)**.
- Displayed consumer prices are in **IRT (Toman)** = `Math.floor(rial / 10)`.
- Standard thousand separator is `,` or `٬`.
- Persian numerals (۰-۹) are native in UI through `Vazirmatn FD` font.
